features.name: Engine Performance
verbatim: It's got great ride quality, powerful engines, ample space on the inside, more features than you would ever need and I think the price is right as well.
2L turbo petrol engine.
Mahindra's petrol and diesel engines were in no need of improvement. They were and still are among the very best, which is why it's no issue that they are unchanged.

There's a 2.2 litre diesel, which is what I'm driving and is what I choose as well. This is an SUV, it's a very comfortable SUV and you're going to want to drive it long distances. And for that, you're going to want a calm, relaxed powertrain and the diesel is all of that and more. It gets up to speed fairly quickly at 100 kilometres per hour, it's fairly silent, the automatic gearbox is smooth and it's genuinely a very nice engine.
The turbo petrol is honestly nicer to drive, it is even more refined and with 200 horsepower it is also bloody fast, but it's also thirsty.
